## Rule
Every healthcheck and keepalive must query the database, so a probe can never pass while the store is unreachable (issue:RTrentJones/RTrentJones.dev#55, commit:RTrentJones/RTrentJones.dev@16cee9a60db9a93d55567bd41d21378a193c0e42).

## Related
The probe half of this failure is the `needs-silence` branch of pattern/probe-touches-wrong-layer: a healthcheck or keepalive aimed at a store-querying route kept the compute awake (commit:RTrentJones/RTrentJones.dev@16cee9a60db9a93d55567bd41d21378a193c0e42).

# Wiki index

## Patterns
- [keepalive-probe-misses-postgres](patterns/keepalive-probe-misses-postgres.md) — hypothesis — a Supabase keepalive that never reaches Postgres.
- [neon-never-sleeps](patterns/neon-never-sleeps.md) — hypothesis — idle-time polling keeps a scale-to-zero compute awake.
- [probe-touches-wrong-layer](patterns/probe-touches-wrong-layer.md) — hypothesis — a probe must touch the layer its liveness model manages: the store for needs-traffic, the application for needs-silence and needs-heal.
append_log: Updated pattern/probe-touches-wrong-layer with a rule conditional on the liveness model, from incident/2026-08-keepalive-green-database-paused (needs-traffic: reach the store) and incident/2026-09-polyphony-neon-never-sleeps (needs-silence: stop at the application). Linked pattern/neon-never-sleeps to it. Statuses unchanged: no deployed red-to-green evidence for the needs-silence side yet.
